planning_notes: Board is authoritative: arduino:avr:uno. Wiring uses A0 (potentiometer), D2 (button with INPUT_PULLUP, pressed is LOW), and D9 (PWM LED).
The controller maps A0 linear 0..1023 to PWM output 0..255 using rounding; set PWM to 0 when D2 is not pressed.
Input change response deadline (<=20ms) is met by using control_period_ms=5ms (worst-case latency bounded by scheduling).
No additional serial reporting or other devices are required by the given requirements.
Because the explicit mapping 0..1023 -> 0..255 is specified, any exact unit scaling/rounding is handled in the SysML model; no fabricated calibration constants are introduced in the device request.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Potentiometer reading used to set LED PWM brightness while button is pressed

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Button pressed state (INPUT_PULLUP; LOW means pressed => model true at LOW)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: LED brightness PWM (0 when button released; otherwise mapped from A0 0..1023 to 0..255 with rounding tolerance 1)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
使用 D2 按钮 + A0 电位器 + D9 LED：按钮按下时电位器控制亮度，否则 LED 关闭
验收约定：D2使用INPUT_PULLUP，低电平表示按下；按下时A0的0..1023线性映射到D9的PWM值0..255（取整容差1），松开时输出0。输入变化响应时间不超过20ms。
